Class Edit

java.lang.Object
edits.Edit
Direct Known Subclasses:
CopyEdit, DeleteEdit, DrawEdit, GroupEdit, MoveEdit
public abstract class Edit extends Object
The Edit class represents an abstract editing operation that can be performed on a MyShape object within a ShapeCanvas.

This class serves as the foundation for the application's undo/redo system. Each concrete subclass represents a specific type of editing action (for example deleting, copying, or moving a shape) and must implement the undo() and redo() methods to reverse or reapply the operation.

Subclasses store references to the affected shape and the canvas on which the operation occurred, allowing the edit to be undone or redone at any time.

This design follows the Command Pattern, where each editing action is encapsulated as an object that knows how to execute, undo, and redo itself.
